plate_comment: Fault 340 (P0106) monitor, run every 20th main-loop phase (about 100 ms at 5 ms per phase) when engine_feature_enable_flags_cal bit 0x80 is set (it is, 0x27ef) and the barometric sensor circuit faults 25 / 26 (P0108 / P0107) are clear. Barometric pressure above barometric_pressure_sensor_maximum_pressure (2012 = 108.4 kPa at 1/18.56 kPa per count) raises barometric_pressure_sensor_above_maximum_debounce_count by 1 per pass up to its limit (20), anything else lowers it by 1 per pass down to 0; at the limit it sets fault 340, at 0 it clears fault 340 and its registered bit. plate_comment: Boost pressure sensor and underboost monitors, run every 20th main-loop phase (about 100 ms at 5 ms per phase) when governor_system_config_flags bit 0x10 is set (it is, 0x0010). While cold_start_phase is CSP_CRANKING (1 = key on, engine speed still below the start trigger), in the four passes that start 25 passes (about 2.5 s) after the initializer, intake manifold pressure above 2254 (121.4 kPa) sets fault 64 (P0236 boost sensor range), otherwise a difference of more than 377 (20.3 kPa) from barometric pressure sets fault 778 (P0069 MAP / barometric correlation; skipped while MAP faults 8 / 9 or barometric faults 25 / 26 / 340 are set). At the governor setpoint while bit 0x2000 of protection_feature_status_flags is set, boost (gauge when protection_sensor_mode_flag is non-zero, else absolute) below 1069 (57.6 kPa) with target speed of at least 2000 rpm and engine load of at least 35 percent sets fault 729 (P0299 underboost), and boost above 1917 (103.3 kPa) with engine load of 7 percent or less sets fault 64; each of those two needs 110 passes of its conditions and then a debounce count above 35, and clears when the count is back at 0 (was cm848_calibration_group21_load).
evidence: fault_setters.py lists faults 64 (P0236), 729 (P0299) and 778 (P0069) for this function and no other; every input is intake manifold pressure (slot 1), barometric pressure (slot 3) or boost above barometric (slot 1 - slot 3) with engine speed / load qualifiers, and the clears are in the same function. cm848_completeBoostPressureMonitorReport already calls these three the Boost / MAP monitor group, so the name covers the whole function (three DTCs, four checks).

plate_comment: EGR delta pressure sensor performance monitor (egr_delta_pressure_sensor_output = sensor channel 105 after autozero), run every 20th main-loop phase; its faults 774-777 have no DTC slot. (1) Key on (switch 0) and cold_start_phase CSP_CRANKING (1 = before the engine starts) with egr_valve_position below the pre-start limit (0 in this ROM), one try per initialization: after 100 passes a reading of more than 126 counts either way sets faults 777 and 774, otherwise 777 is cleared. (2) With bit 0x10000 of protection_feature_status_flags set, below 1800 rpm, engine load under 3.1 percent and egr_valve_position under 70 percent: a reading above 251 for 100 passes sets 775 and 774, 126 or less for 100 passes clears 775. (3) Above 2200 rpm, engine load above 3.1 percent and egr_valve_position above 20 percent: a reading below -63 for 100 passes sets 776 and 774, 126 or more for 100 passes clears 776. Fault 774 clears with the last of 775 / 776 / 777; every check stops while EGR valve position sensor faults 642 / 643, delta pressure sensor faults 690 / 691, fault 725 or faults 514 / 515 are set. The tail sets bit 16 of diagnostic_monitor_complete_bits (was cm848_calibration_group22_load).
evidence: PROVEN: the only measurement is egr_delta_pressure_sensor_output (autozeroed channel 105, e2m EGR_Delta_Press_Sensor, IN_HG at 0.0159 per count); the checks are gated by the circuit faults of both sensor channels (75 valve position: call args 0x282 / 0x283, 105 delta pressure: 0x2b2 / 0x2b3); the limits are round in the sensor's own unit (251 / 126 / -63 counts = 4.0 / 2.0 / -1.0 inHg); the pre-start test is a zero-offset test that any healthy system must pass. INFERRED: the two in-operation tests are sensor plausibility checks (they could equally flag the EGR system); faults 774-777 have no DTC slot and no consumer, and the e2m list has no matching limit parameters, so the name rests on the signal tested.

plate_comment: One-shot plausibility check of the fuel temperature sensor after a cold soak (fault 402, no DTC slot), run every 20th main-loop phase; it needs operating_mode_flags_cal bit 0x100 (clear in this calibration, 0x7ca6, so it never starts) and bit 0x40 of protection_feature_status_flags. At the first pass with cold_start_phase CSP_CRANKING (1 = key on, before the engine starts), with coolant at or below 6400 (100 F) and less than 640 (10 F) above battery_temperature_sensor_filtered (the soak qualifier) and no coolant (16 / 17), battery temperature (379 / 380), fuel temperature circuit (47) or fault 410 set, fuel_temperature_sensor_filtered above 9600 (150 F, 1/64 F per count) sets fault 402. fuel_temperature_sensor_cold_soak_check_state records skipped / fault / passed and cm848_completeFuelTemperatureSensorColdSoakCheckReport finishes it; the function never clears fault 402 (was cm848_calibration_group37_load).
evidence: The old plate reading (a coolant-vs-ambient temperature check) is wrong: coolant minus battery temperature (slot 69) is only the soak qualifier, and the quantity tested is fuel_temperature_sensor_filtered (lha 0x40bafe = slot 7, ET1 SPN 174) against a 150 F ROM limit, with the fuel temperature channel's own circuit fault 47 as a gate. Fault 402 is the only fault it sets; no function clears it with an and-mask (grep of the whole .cpp for the 0xfffb mask on fault_detected_bits_400_to_415 finds nothing), so only generic fault clearing can heal it.

plate_comment: Completion of the fuel temperature cold-soak check (monitor group 11, no P-code): when the previous-pass copy of fault 402 (bit 2 of fault_detected_bits_400_to_415) equals its current state it sets bit 11 of diagnostic_monitor_complete_bits, clears the matching bit of fault_pending_flags / fault_pending_flags_b and returns 1, else it returns 0 (was cm848_completeMonitorGroup11Report).
evidence: A grep of the whole .cpp finds its two call sites only in the cold-soak check (states 2 and 3), and it tests only fault 402; the old plate's coolant-vs-ambient description of that caller does not hold.

evidence: Its only store is 0x40b9b6 = 0; the check itself later stores states 1-5 (sth r31,0(r30) @ 0x5305c0, which a linear sweep misses), and the word is read only by the check and its report function.

Nothing in it is an oil temperature; it is 0 in the dump because the check is disabled by operating_mode_flags_cal.
ROM word 9600 = 150 F at 1/64 F per count: fuel_temperature_sensor_filtered above this after a cold soak sets fault 402 (lha @ 0x530544).
ROM word 6400 = 100 F: the check runs only with coolant at or below this (lha @ 0x53050c).

ROM word 640 = 10 F: coolant minus battery_temperature_sensor_filtered must be below this (soak qualifier, signed subtract, lhz @ 0x530520). Dump: coolant 2049, battery temperature 2086, fuel temperature 4608 (72 F).

text: COLD_START_PHASE member CSP_CRANKING (1) is a misname lead: cm848_initCrankingLimits (0x1c978) sets it at initialization, the state machine at 0x1c480 enters it from CSP_ENGINE_STANDBY on key-on with 0 rpm and leaves it only when current_rpm exceeds engine_rpm_trigger_cal (to CSP_ABOVE_RPM_TRIGGER) or the key line is low / engine_starting is 1 (to CSP_ENGINE_STANDBY); the RAM dump has it at 1 with 0 rpm, and the engine hour meter does not count while it is 1. So it means key on, before the engine has started (including actual cranking), and the enum comment Engine at idle/crank speed is misleading; the names here say pre_start, like hpcr_checkRailPressureSensorBeforeStart and fuel_pressure_sensor_pre_start_*.

Fault 777 is missing from fault_setters.py for cm848_calibration_group22_load: the pre-start failure path writes uVar2 = fault_detected_bits_768_to_783 | 0x240 through a temporary (asm ori ...,512 @ 0x52e42c plus the 774 bit), which the script's direct-assignment pattern does not match; the 0xc0 and 0x140 writes are direct, hence only 774 / 775 / 776 were listed. The monitor sets and clears faults 774, 775, 776 and 777.

Scheduling: each monitor is called twice per 40-phase main_loop cycle, 20 phases apart (group 36 in phases 11 / 31, group 37 in 12 / 32, group 21 in 16 / 36, group 22 in 17 / 37), so a pass is about 100 ms if a phase is 5 ms (CLAUDE.md: 40 phases = 0.200 s). The four callers (hpcr_periodicTaskGroup36_calibration15, cm848_periodicTaskGroup37_calibration16, cm848_periodicTaskGroup21_calibration, cm848_periodicTaskGroup22_calibration) each run several unrelated monitors, so they keep their scheduler-group names.

Static enables from the EEPROM dump (originals/cm848_eeprom.bin): engine_feature_enable_flags_cal (0x16a) = 0x27ef has bit 0x80 set, so the barometric monitor is on; governor_system_config_flags (0x3fd5d2 = EEPROM 0x150) = 0x0010 has bit 0x10 set, so the boost monitor is on (that address is inside the EEPROM mirror, so the name would need _cal); operating_mode_flags_cal (0x16c) = 0x7ca6 has bit 0x100 clear, so the fuel temperature cold-soak check never starts in this calibration.

protection_feature_status_flags (0x40b9d0, dword) is NOT a static configuration: cm848_calibration_group27_load (0x531900) rebuilds all 32 bits every pass as monitor-n enabling conditions met (cold_start_phase compares, battery voltage flags, ... masked by the ROM tables at 0x6430e / 0x6438e and fault_mask_inverted). Its dump value 0x06ff4040 has bit 13 (0x2000, the underboost and boost-high checks) clear only because the engine was not running; bit 6 (0x40, fuel temperature check) and bit 16 (0x10000, EGR delta pressure checks) are set. Rename candidate for a later wave (monitor enable condition bits); cm848_calibration_group27_load is a placeholder name too.

protection_sensor_mode_flag (0x3feff6, word, never written, 1 in the dump): when non-zero, cm848_calculateBoostPressure returns gauge boost (intake manifold pressure minus barometric pressure), else the absolute manifold pressure; the boost monitor, cm848_monitorWastegateBoostPressure and cm848_monitorOverboostAndHighLoadBoostBand pick between boost_pressure_above_barometric and intake_manifold_pressure the same way. The name (bare protection, sensor mode) does not say that; a name like boost_pressure_gauge_mode_flag would. Not proposed as a row: five functions outside this group read it.

hpcr_fuelFinal_periodic (0x5022cc) is not a fuel function: it selects the barometric pressure. While fault 25 / 26, or 340 / 778 (each gated by its fault_status_array entry and a bit of fuel_boost_final_fault_gate_enable: bit 4 for 340, bit 7 for 778) is active it sets barometric_pressure_selected to barometric_pressure_sensor_default_value and fuel_boost_mode_state to 2, else to barometric_pressure_sensor_value and 0. Rename candidate cm848_selectBarometricPressure. cm848_calibrationGroup5_periodic (0x502464) applies fuel_limit_barometric_air_handling_fault_grid on the same faults. This is the evidence that faults 340 and 778 are barometric-sensor faults.

Fault identities used above: 25 / 26 = barometric sensor circuit high / low (P0108 / P0107; sensor channel 3 call arguments 0x19, 0x1a), 8 / 9 = MAP sensor circuit high / low (P0238 / P0237; channel 1 arguments 8, 9), 16 / 17 = coolant temperature circuit (P0118 / P0117), 379 / 380 = battery temperature circuit (P0517 / P0516), 47 / 48 = fuel temperature channel 7 circuit high / low (arguments 0x2f, 0x30; no DTC slot), 642 / 643 = EGR valve position channel 75 circuit faults, 690 / 691 = EGR delta pressure channel 105 circuit faults (no DTC slots). Faults 774-777 have no reader outside the monitor and its completion test (mask 0x40).

Initializer numbering: the cm848_initialization_groupN_state numbers do not follow the load numbers. 0x52dd28 (group22_state) initializes the coolant temperature monitor (engine_cssc_coolant_state), 0x52e24c (group29_state) initializes the EGR delta pressure monitor, 0x5305dc (group37_state) initializes cm848_main_loop_protection_eval (0x53064c), and the fuel temperature check's own initializer is 0x530364 (group13_state). Pairing here was done by the state words each one stores (sweep of both banks, checked against the disassembly).

cm848_calibration_group21_load_cont (0x52eae8) with its initializer cm848_initialization_group22_state_cont (0x52eac8) is NOT part of the boost monitor: it is a separate monitor (cam_sync_* state, sets bits 0 / 1 of the fault word 512-527 = engine_sync_validation_flags, reads faults 796 / 797, egr_valve_position and fuel_feature_control_flags) that needs its own review.

j1939_message_state_flags_b (0x3fea18) is the registered twin of word 32 (0x3fe9d8 + 2 x 32): rename candidate fault_registered_bits_512_to_527, to go with fault_detected_bits_512_to_527 for 0x3fe9b4.

Counting against the 10-globals-per-function limit: boost detector 10 + the state-code word counted with its initializer; EGR delta pressure detector 6 limit words + 3 fault words, its initializer the 9 state words.
